title: UniviewVLA: A Unified Multiview Vision-Language-Action Model with World Modeling
summary: Occluded tasks remain a bottleneck in robot manipulation. Existing solutions either deploy additional physical cameras requiring training-inference camera parity, or rely on explicit 3D reconstruction with high computational cost. Moreover, both approaches rely on standard agent-view and wrist-view observations, while failing to capture occlusion information and future scene evolution. To this end, we propose UniviewVLA, a unified multiview Vision-Language-Action model with world modeling, which infers multiview scene evolution for action prediction from only standard two-camera observations. We demonstrate that by leveraging generated multiview future views from the world model, UniviewVLA reveals occluded cues and models future scene evolution, improving action prediction and removing the need for extra hardware or explicit reconstruction. Besides, to accelerate inference while preserving prediction accuracy, UniviewVLA develops Motion-Informative Token Compression, which compresses each generated view from 625 to 16 tokens and reduces per-view latency from 6-7s to 0.2-0.3s. UniviewVLA also proposes training-free Action-Entropy View Selection, which dynamically identifies the most action-informative view at different inference stages. Extensive experiments show that UniviewVLA achieves 95.8% on LIBERO and 4.60 on CALVIN ABCD to D, both standard occlusion-free benchmarks. On customized occlusion-focused tasks, it improves success rate from 40.0% to 73.3%, and average real-robot success rate by 33.4 points, demonstrating stronger occlusion-focused performance without sacrificing standard occlusion-free benchmarks.
tldr: UniviewVLA is a unified multiview VLA model that uses a world model to generate occluded future views from only two standard camera inputs, improving robot action prediction without extra hardware or explicit 3D reconstruction.
tldr_zh: UniviewVLA 是一个统一的多视角视觉-语言-动作模型，通过世界模型从仅有的两个标准摄像头输入生成被遮挡的未来视图，从而在没有额外硬件或显式3D重建的情况下改进机器人动作预测。
summary_zh: 遮挡任务仍是机器人操作中的瓶颈。现有解决方案要么部署额外物理摄像头并要求训练-推理阶段相机参数一致，要么依赖计算成本高昂的显式三维重建。此外，这两种方法都仅使用标准智能体视角和腕部视角观测，既无法捕捉遮挡信息，也无法预测未来场景演化。为此，我们提出UniviewVLA——一种具备世界建模能力的统一多视图视觉-语言-动作模型，仅需标准双摄像头观测即可推断多视图场景演化并预测动作。实验证明，通过利用世界模型生成的多视图未来画面，UniviewVLA能够揭示被遮挡线索并建模未来场景演变，从而提升动作预测性能，同时消除额外硬件或显式重建需求。此外，为在保持预测精度的同时加速推理，UniviewVLA开发了运动信息感知令牌压缩技术，将每个生成视图从625个令牌压缩至16个，并将单视图处理延迟从6-7秒降至0.2-0.3秒。UniviewVLA还提出了无需训练的动作熵视角选择机制，可在不同推理阶段动态识别最具动作信息量的视角。大量实验表明，UniviewVLA在标准无遮挡基准测试中达LIBERO 95.8%和CALVIN ABCD→D 4.60分。在定制化遮挡聚焦任务中，成功率从40.0%提升至73.3%，真实机器人平均成功率提高33.4个百分点，在无损标准无遮挡基准性能的前提下展现出更强的遮挡处理能力。

title: Robot Self-Improvement via Human-Video Dynamics Models
summary: A central question in robot learning is how to acquire skills from the kinds of data that humans learn from: passive observation, embodied practice, and the experience of failure. Human videos provide the first of these in abundance, and prior work has shown they can initialize useful policies. Far less clear is whether they can support the second and third: whether priors extracted from human videos can ground a robot's own attempts well enough to evaluate them, correct them, and improve from them. In this work, we show that human videos can be used to learn embodiment-agnostic action, dynamics, and value representations that transfer across robot embodiments, providing the predictive foundation required for robots to autonomously improve from their own rollouts and failures. We introduce Dynamics-Guided Action Correction (DGAC), a training-free approach that leverages these adapted models to repair failed states: each failure becomes a query for which the learned models propose and rank corrective actions, turning failures into supervision for the next policy update. Across seven real-world manipulation tasks spanning both a mobile manipulator and a static manipulator arm, our approach improves success rates from 40% to 81% across multiple policy backbones, demonstrating cross-embodiment robot self-improvement from human-video priors. These results show that human priors and robot failures can be combined to enable scalable autonomous policy improvement. Project page: https://ethz-mrl.github.io/robot-self-improvement-website/.
tldr: This paper shows that human video data can provide embodiment-agnostic action, dynamics, and value representations that enable robots to autonomously correct failures and improve policies across different embodiments, leading to a significant boost in real-world manipulation success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文表明，人类视频数据可以提供跨具身的动作、动力学和值表示，使机器人能够自主纠正失败并改进策略，在多种真实操控任务上显著提升成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人学习的核心问题在于如何从人类学习所依赖的数据类型中获取技能：被动观察、具身实践以及失败经验。人类视频提供了第一种数据的大量来源，已有研究表明这类数据可用于初始化有效的策略。但远未明确的是，它们是否能够支撑后两种数据类型：即从人类视频中提取的先验知识是否足以使机器人充分评估自身的尝试、纠正错误并从失败中改进。在本研究中，我们表明人类视频可用于学习与具身形式无关的动作、动力学及价值表征，这些表征可跨机器人本体迁移，为机器人基于自身试错与失败经验自主改进提供所需的预测基础。我们提出动力学引导的动作修正（DGAC）方法——一种无需训练的框架，通过适配模型对失败状态进行修复：每次失败转化为一个查询，学习模型据此提出并排序修正动作，将失败转化为下一次策略更新的监督信号。在包含移动操作臂与静态操作臂的七项真实世界操作任务中，我们的方法将多种策略主干下的成功率从40%提升至81%，展示了基于人类视频先验的跨本体机器人自我改进能力。这些结果表明，人类先验知识与机器人失败经验可相互结合，实现可扩展的自主策略优化。项目页面：https://ethz-mrl.github.io/robot-self-improvement-website/。

title: FOCA: Future-Oriented Conditioning for Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Adaptation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable general-purpose robotic control via large-scale multimodal pretraining, yet their effectiveness under few-shot imitation learning remains limited. We conduct a systematic stress test of state-of-the-art VLA models and show that performance degrades sharply as demonstrations are reduced, revealing a key weakness of existing adaptation strategies. To address this, we introduce FOCA, a future-oriented conditioning framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation. FOCA combines explicit prediction of task-grounded future interaction embeddings with implicit alignment to future goal observations, enabling long-horizon reasoning in latent space without pixel-level prediction. This formulation naturally supports action-free co-training with synthetic videos from video world models and can be interpreted as learning a future-conditioned value-like representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate FOCA achieves 95.7% success with 20 demonstrations on LIBERO, improves 7-12% on RoboCasa, and delivers up to 26% absolute gains on real robots, establishing a new state of the art in few-shot VLA adaptation.
tldr: FOCA introduces a future-oriented conditioning framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation, combining explicit prediction of task-grounded future interaction embeddings with implicit alignment to future goal observations, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot imitation learning on real robots.
tldr_zh: FOCA提出了一种面向未来的条件框架，用于数据高效的VLA适应，结合显式的任务相关未来交互嵌入预测与隐式的未来目标观测对齐，在真实机器人上实现了少样本模仿学习的最先进性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过大规模多模态预训练实现了通用机器人控制，但在少样本模仿学习场景下其有效性仍受局限。我们对当前最先进的VLA模型进行了系统性压力测试，结果表明，随着演示样本的减少，模型性能急剧下降，揭示了现有适应策略的关键缺陷。为解决这一问题，我们提出FOCA——一种面向未来的条件框架，用于实现数据高效的VLA适应。FOCA将基于任务场景的未来交互嵌入显式预测与对未来目标观测的隐式对齐相结合，从而在潜空间中实现长程推理，无需像素级预测。该公式天然支持基于视频世界模型生成的合成视频进行无动作协同训练，并可解释为学习一种未来条件化的类价值表征。大量实验表明，FOCA在LIBERO数据集上仅需20个演示即可达到95.7%的成功率，在RoboCasa数据集上提升7-12%，在真实机器人上取得高达26%的绝对性能增益，确立了少样本VLA适应的新标杆。

title: Semi-Supervised Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from visual observations and language instructions, but adapting them to new environments still depends on costly action-labeled demonstrations. To reduce this dependence, we study semi-supervised VLA adaptation under limited supervision signals, where only a small portion of trajectories contain robot actions and the remaining trajectories provide action-unlabeled vision-language observations. Unlike standard semi-supervised learning, the missing supervision is an embodied action signal that must be visually grounded, language-consistent, physically feasible, and temporally stable. To address this problem, we propose SemiVLA, a self-distilled teacher-student framework that learns from reliable pseudo-actions on unlabeled trajectories. SemiVLA introduces a VLA-specific reliability controller to assess vision-language alignment, action feasibility, and temporal transition consistency, and further updates the teacher through a Bottleneck-Projected Alignment Update to avoid noisy feedback contamination. With OpenVLA as the backbone, SemiVLA consistently improves multiple PEFT strategies across LIBERO and CALVIN. Under 10\% labeled trajectories, SemiVLA with Selective LoRA achieves 89.0\% average success on LIBERO, outperforming supervised LoRA by 8.0 points without extra inference cost.
tldr: This paper proposes SemiVLA, a semi-supervised teacher-student framework for adapting VLA models with limited action-labeled data, using a reliability controller to generate pseudo-actions and a Bottleneck-Projected Alignment Update to avoid noisy feedback.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出SemiVLA，一种半监督教师-学生框架，用于在有限动作标注数据下适应VLA模型，通过可靠性控制器生成伪动作并使用瓶颈投影对齐更新避免噪声反馈。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使机器人能够直接从视觉观察和语言指令中预测动作，但其在新环境中的适应性仍依赖于成本高昂的动作标注演示数据。为降低这种依赖，我们研究了有限监督信号下的半监督VLA自适应方法，其中仅少量轨迹包含机器人动作，其余轨迹仅提供无动作标注的视觉-语言观测数据。与标准半监督学习不同，缺失的监督信号是一种具身动作信号，必须满足视觉可定位、语言一致性、物理可行性及时序稳定性等要求。为解决该问题，我们提出SemiVLA框架——一种自蒸馏师生学习框架，能够从未标注轨迹中学习可靠的伪动作信号。SemiVLA引入针对VLA模型的可靠性控制器，用于评估视觉-语言对齐度、动作可行性及时序过渡一致性，并通过瓶颈投影对齐更新机制更新教师模型，避免噪声反馈污染。以OpenVLA为骨干网络，SemiVLA在LIBERO和CALVIN数据集上持续改进多种参数高效微调策略。在仅使用10%标注轨迹的情况下，采用选择性LoRA的SemiVLA在LIBERO数据集上取得89.0%的平均成功率，较监督LoRA方法提升8.0个百分点，且未增加额外推理成本。

title: Energy-based Compositional Diffusion Planning
summary: Compositional diffusion planners aim to solve long-horizon robotic tasks using short training trajectories. Yet, current approaches often rely on the heuristic stitching of local predictions. We show that the resulting stitched update is generally a non-conservative field} that does not mathematically correspond to any valid global trajectory log-density function. We propose Energy-based Compositional Diffuser (ECD), a framework that formulates the global trajectory as the minimizer of the sum of local bridge potentials. This energy-based perspective defines a conservative correction field and contains a boundary reaction term that heuristic stitching omits. To enable efficient inference, we further introduce a Markov-based score approximation that computes the reaction term via a single block-tridiagonal solve, maintaining time complexity linear in the planning horizon. Empirically, ECD achieves state-of-the-art success rates on a range of OGBench stitching tasks, while nearly matching the inference speed of heuristic stitching methods. Code is available at https://github.com/GradientSpaces/ECD.
tldr: ECD formulates compositional diffusion planning as minimizing the sum of local bridge potentials, providing a conservative correction field and a boundary reaction term for long-horizon robotic tasks, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on OGBench stitching tasks.
tldr_zh: ECD将组合扩散规划公式化为最小化局部桥势能之和，提供了保守校正场和边界反应项，用于长时域机器人任务，在OGBench拼接任务上取得了最优成功率。
summary_zh: 组合扩散规划器旨在利用短时训练轨迹解决长时域机器人任务，但现有方法通常依赖局部预测的启发式拼接。我们证明，这种拼接更新本质上是一个非保守场，数学上不对应于任何有效的全局轨迹对数密度函数。为此，我们提出基于能量的组合扩散器（ECD）框架，将全局轨迹定义为局部桥势能之和的最小化器。该基于能量的视角定义了一个保守修正场，并包含了启发式拼接所忽略的边界反应项。为支持高效推理，我们进一步引入基于马尔可夫的分数近似方法，通过单次块三对角求解计算反应项，其时间复杂度与规划时域呈线性关系。实验结果表明，ECD在OGBench系列拼接任务中达到了最先进水平，同时推理速度几乎与启发式拼接方法持平。代码已开源：https://github.com/GradientSpaces/ECD。

title: VQActFlow: Vector-Quantized Action Mode Steering for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
summary: Multi-task robot manipulation policies are challenging to learn from demonstration because traditionally a single network must select among qualitatively different action modes from a multimodal demonstration distribution, conditioned on language and visual context. A wrong mode selection means executing the wrong task or an action infeasible in the scene. Tokenizing continuous actions into a learned discrete codebook separates these modes at the representation level, offering structural advantages for multi-task learning. We propose VQActFlow, a multi-task manipulation policy that tokenizes action chunks and generates code sequences via Variational Flow Matching. VQActFlow maintains an explicit preference over action modes throughout generation. Inference-time guidance acts on this preference to steer mode commitment. We instantiate this with classifier-free guidance over language conditioning, which steers the policy toward the instructed action mode, and a learned codebook critic that supplies a complementary feasibility signal. We evaluate VQActFlow on three platforms: the LIBERO simulation benchmarks, a Unitree G1 humanoid performing whole-body pick-and-place, and an ALOHA-style bimanual platform performing contact-rich tasks. Across these benchmarks, VQActFlow outperforms both continuous and discrete baselines.
tldr: VQActFlow tokenizes continuous robot action chunks into a discrete codebook and generates code sequences via variational flow matching, enabling inference-time guidance to steer action modes for multi-task manipulation.
tldr_zh: VQActFlow将连续机器人动作片段标记化为离散码本，并通过变分流匹配生成码序列，在推理时通过引导来操控动作模式，实现多任务操作。
summary_zh: 多任务机器人操作策略难以从示范中学习，因为传统上单个网络必须基于语言和视觉上下文，从多模态示范分布中在性质不同的动作模式间进行选择。错误的模式选择意味着执行错误的任务或场景中不可行的动作。将连续动作令牌化为学习到的离散码本，可在表示层面分离这些模式，为多任务学习提供结构优势。我们提出VQActFlow，一种通过变分流匹配对动作片段进行令牌化并生成代码序列的多任务操作策略。VQActFlow在整个生成过程中保持对动作模式的显式偏好，并通过推理时引导作用于该偏好以调节模式选择。我们通过两种方式实现这一机制：基于语言条件的无分类器引导，将策略导向指令指定的动作模式；以及学习到的码本评判器，提供互补的可行性信号。我们在三个平台上评估VQActFlow：LIBERO仿真基准测试、执行全身抓取放置任务的Unitree G1人形机器人，以及执行接触密集任务的ALOHA式双臂平台。在这些基准测试中，VQActFlow均优于连续和离散基线方法。

title: Robot Critics that Sweat the Small Stuff
summary: Large vision-language models contain several priors about the world and object interactions, making them useful critics during inference to steer robot policies towards success. However, closed-loop robot manipulation requires judging small visual differences between success and failure, which remains a challenge for current VLMs. We introduce a method to fine-tune critics by constructing pairwise progress supervision using success and failure rollouts obtained from a policy. Our fine-tuned critic excels at fine-grained progress reasoning and subtle failure detection, outperforming prior progress reasoning baselines. Additionally, we use an action-conditioned video model to predict the visual effect of several candidate actions sampled from a policy, and show that our critic can correctly identify successful candidates to execute, improving the average policy success rate by 11% across real-world tasks and 5.9% across simulation tasks.
tldr: This paper proposes fine-tuning a VLM-based critic with pairwise progress supervision from policy rollouts, enabling fine-grained success/failure judgment for robot manipulation, and uses an action-conditioned video model to rank candidate actions, improving policy success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出通过策略回滚中的成对进展监督来微调基于VLM的评论家，使其能够对机器人操作中的成功/失败进行细粒度判断，并利用动作条件视频模型对候选动作排序，从而提高策略成功率。
summary_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型蕴含关于世界及物体交互的多重先验知识，使其在推理阶段可成为引导机器人策略走向成功的有力评判者。然而，闭环机器人操控需要判断成功与失败之间的微小视觉差异，这对当前视觉-语言模型仍构成挑战。我们提出一种方法，通过利用策略执行中获取的成功与失败轨迹构建成对进度监督信号，对评判器进行微调。经微调的评判器在细粒度进度推理与细微失败检测方面表现卓越，超越现有进度推理基线方法。此外，我们采用动作条件视频模型预测从策略中采样的多个候选动作的视觉效果，实验表明，该评判器能正确识别可成功执行的候选动作，使实际任务的平均策略成功率提升11%，仿真任务提升5.9%。

title: A Stitch in Time Saves Nine: Preserving Policy Compatibility Under Perception Updates in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving systems tightly couple perception and decision-making through latent representations. Consequently, updates to perception models can alter these representations and degrade the performance of downstream policies that remain fixed. Existing solutions typically rely on policy retraining or architectural decoupling, both of which incur substantial computation and validation costs. In this paper, we formulate the model stitching problem for end-to-end autonomous driving and test the hypothesis that policy compatibility can be preserved through lightweight latent-space alignment. We study low-complexity model stitching methods, including linear and convolutional stitchers, for restoring compatibility between updated perception modules and frozen downstream policy modules. Experiments demonstrate that stitching effectively preserves downstream driving behavior under diverse perception updates, including changes in random initialization, sensor configuration, and training domain. In the most challenging cross-domain setting from nuScenes to CARLA, convolutional stitching retains over 91\% of the no-shift driving score while reducing adaptation time from \SI{22.18}{h} to \SI{0.91}{h}. These results suggest that model stitching provides an effective and computationally efficient alternative to retraining or fine-tuning for maintaining end-to-end autonomous driving systems. The model will be open-sourced upon paper acceptance at https://github.com/SCP-CN-001/model-stitching to support further research and development in autonomous driving.
tldr: Model stitching preserves policy compatibility under perception updates in end-to-end autonomous driving via lightweight latent-space alignment, significantly reducing adaptation cost.
tldr_zh: 通过轻量级潜空间对齐，模型拼接可在端到端自动驾驶感知更新时保持策略兼容性，大幅降低适配成本。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶系统通过潜在表征紧密耦合感知与决策过程。因此，感知模型的更新会改变这些表征，并导致固定不变的下游策略性能下降。现有解决方案通常依赖策略重训练或架构解耦，这两种方法均需耗费大量计算与验证成本。本文针对端到端自动驾驶系统提出模型拼接问题，并验证了通过轻量级潜在空间对齐可保持策略兼容性的假设。我们研究了包括线性拼接器和卷积拼接器在内的低复杂度模型拼接方法，以恢复更新后感知模块与冻结下游策略模块之间的兼容性。实验表明，在随机初始化、传感器配置和训练域等多样化感知更新场景下，拼接技术能够有效保留下游驾驶行为。在从nuScenes到CARLA的最具挑战性跨域设置中，卷积拼接保留了91%以上的无偏移驾驶评分，同时将自适应时间从22.18小时缩减至0.91小时。这些结果表明，对于维护端到端自动驾驶系统而言，模型拼接提供了一种比重训练或微调更高效且计算成本更低的替代方案。论文被录用后，相关模型将在https://github.com/SCP-CN-001/model-stitching开源，以支持自动驾驶领域的进一步研究与开发。

title: Decoupling the Declarative from the Procedural in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Deploying generalist robotic agents in the real world requires transferable skills. Specifically, a policy trained to clone a behavior from object-specific demonstrations must generalize beyond that object, otherwise data collection requirements become intractable. Recently, fine-tuning of pre-trained billion-parameter Vision-Language Models (VLMs), initially on large-scale robot datasets and then on fewer scenario-specific demonstrations, has emerged as the predominant paradigm for designing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. While these policies achieve state-of-the-art manipulation performance in-distribution, they remain brittle to minor spatial, semantic, and task variations. In this work, we address the inability of current models to decouple the declarative (i.e., concepts and entity semantics) from the procedural knowledge (i.e., how to do something) encoded in their parameters, which is a fundamental bottleneck for zero-shot skill transfer to novel objects. To address this, we propose w$^{2}$VLA, a new VLA model with restructured information flow. Rather than feeding all multimodal tokens from the VLM encoder into a large, opaque transformer-based action expert, our approach modulates the robot state sequence with visual, spatial, and skill information in a compositional and interpretable manner. Unlike popular, state-of-the-art VLAs, we show that our modular approach successfully decouples knowledge representations, enabling robust behavior cloning and unprecedented zero-shot skill transfer capabilities across dissimilar, unseen objects.
tldr: Proposes w²VLA, a VLA model with modular information flow that decouples declarative knowledge (concepts, semantics) from procedural knowledge (action execution), enabling zero-shot skill transfer to novel objects in behavior cloning.
tldr_zh: 提出w²VLA，一种具有模块化信息流的VLA模型，将陈述性知识（概念、语义）与程序性知识（动作执行）解耦，在行为克隆中实现对未见物体的零样本技能迁移。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在现实世界中部署通用机器人智能体需要具备可迁移的技能。具体而言，一个通过从特定物体演示中克隆行为训练得到的策略，必须能够泛化到该物体之外，否则数据收集的需求将变得难以处理。近年来，对预训练的十亿参数视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行微调（首先在大规模机器人数据集上，然后在较少场景特定演示上），已成为设计视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的主流范式。尽管这些策略在分布内实现了最先进的操作性能，但它们对于细微的空间、语义和任务变化仍然脆弱。在本工作中，我们指出当前模型无法解耦其参数中编码的陈述性知识（即概念与实体语义）与程序性知识（即如何执行操作），这是实现零样本技能迁移到新物体的根本瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出了w²VLA——一种具有重组信息流的新型VLA模型。我们的方法并非将VLM编码器产生的所有多模态标记输入到基于Transformer的大型不透明动作专家中，而是以组合且可解释的方式，用视觉、空间和技能信息来调节机器人状态序列。与流行的最先进VLA模型不同，我们证明这种模块化方法成功解耦了知识表征，从而在异构且未见过的物体上实现了稳健的行为克隆与前所未有的零样本技能迁移能力。

title: ASCII Art Turns LLMs into VLA Controllers
summary: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) controllers are often built by extending vision--language models (VLMs) with action supervision, relying on multimodal backbones with large data and compute requirements. We demonstrate that a text-only large language model (LLM) can be adapted into a VLA-style controller when visual observations are rendered into a text input using an ASCII representation. This ASCII-as-vision interface enables existing training and deployment stacks for LLMs to efficiently condition on visual state, follow natural-language instructions, and produce constrained, executable actions. We fine-tune and compare multiple LLMs and VLMs across model families and scales, using both expert demonstrations from a planning-based teacher, as well as DAgger for iterative improvement. In a 2D manipulation benchmark, in both simulation and on a physical manipulator, the resulting controllers can identify task-relevant entities and plan feasible action sequences. Our results suggest that ASCII rendering can serve as a lightweight, interpretable modality bridge from images to text, complementing conventional VLA pipelines, and opening directions for VLA research with text-only backbones.
tldr: This paper shows that a text-only LLM can serve as a VLA controller by converting visual observations into ASCII art, achieving lightweight, interpretable robotic control without multimodal backbones.
tldr_zh: 该论文证明，通过将视觉观察转换为ASCII艺术，纯文本LLM可作为VLA控制器，实现轻量级、可解释的机器人控制，无需多模态骨干网络。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）控制器通常通过扩展视觉-语言模型（VLM）并添加动作监督来构建，依赖于具有大量数据和计算需求的多模态骨干网络。我们证明，当视觉观察通过ASCII表示渲染为文本输入时，纯文本大语言模型（LLM）可以被适配为VLA风格的控制器。这种“以ASCII作为视觉”的接口使得现有的LLM训练和部署流程能够高效地以视觉状态为条件，遵循自然语言指令，并生成受限的可执行动作。我们微调并比较了多个来自不同模型家族和规模的LLM与VLM，采用基于规划教师模型的专家示范以及DAgger方法进行迭代改进。在二维操作基准测试中，无论是仿真环境还是实体机械臂上，所得到的控制器均能识别任务相关实体并规划可行的动作序列。我们的结果表明，ASCII渲染可以作为一种轻量级、可解释的图像到文本模态桥梁，补充传统VLA流程，并为基于纯文本骨干网络的VLA研究开辟新方向。

title: BIT-Nav: Brain-Inspired Trajectory Memory for Embodied Navigation
summary:
Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for embodied navigation rely on selecting a fixed number of frames from a growing trajectory history. As episodes extend, this selection grows increasingly sparse, yet prior work shows no accuracy gain when scaling from 8 to 64 frames, suggesting the bottleneck is not frame quantity but the representation itself. Sparse frame selection cannot capture the structured behavioral signal that long-horizon reasoning requires: turning patterns, cumulative displacement, and path topology.
  We introduce BIT-Nav (Brain-Inspired Trajectory Memory for Navigation), a framework that augments frozen VLM navigation pipelines with a compact learned trajectory memory. Motivated by hippocampal path integration, where spatial experience is compressed into structured episodic traces rather than stored as raw sensory replay, BIT-Nav trains a Bi-GRU encoder over action and relative pose sequences via a multi-positive InfoNCE contrastive objective on trajectory prefixes sharing the same behavioral intent. The resulting embedding is projected into the VLM token space via a lightweight MLP and injected as a single memory token at each decision step, conditioning the model on structured motion history at constant token cost regardless of episode length
tldr: BIT-Nav augments frozen VLM navigation pipelines with a compact learned trajectory memory inspired by hippocampal path integration, enabling constant token cost for structured motion history regardless of episode length.
tldr_zh: BIT-Nav 受海马体路径整合启发，为冻结的VLM导航流水线增补了一个紧凑的轨迹记忆，以恒定令牌成本编码结构化运动历史，不受轨迹长度影响。
summary_zh:
视觉-语言模型（VLM）在具身导航中依赖从不断增长的轨迹历史中选择固定数量的帧。随着任务片段的延长，这种选择变得越来越稀疏，然而先前的研究表明，将帧数从8扩展到64时并未带来精度提升，这表明瓶颈并非帧数量，而是表征本身。稀疏的帧选择无法捕捉长时程推理所需的结构化行为信号：转向模式、累积位移和路径拓扑。

我们提出BIT-Nav（仿脑启发的导航轨迹记忆），该框架通过一个紧凑的学习型轨迹记忆来增强冻结的VLM导航流程。受海马体路径整合机制的启发——即空间经验被压缩为结构化的情景痕迹，而非以原始感官回放的形式存储——BIT-Nav在动作与相对位姿序列上训练双向门控循环单元（Bi-GRU）编码器，并对共享相同行为意图的轨迹前缀采用多正例InfoNCE对比目标。生成的嵌入通过轻量级MLP投影至VLM的令牌空间，在每个决策步骤作为单一记忆令牌注入，使模型以恒定的令牌开销（与片段长度无关）对结构化运动历史进行条件化建模。

title: NAC: Neural Action Codec for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models rely on discrete action tokenizers to bridge continuous robot control and autoregressive sequence modeling, yet existing tokenizers often trade off between compression, latency, and downstream performance. We revisit this design through the lens of neural audio codecs-convolutional encoder-decoder architectures with residual vector quantization that serve as the standard front end for audio foundation models. Motivated by their success, we introduce the Neural Action Codec (NAC), which treats short robot action trajectories as multi-channel 1D signals and compresses them using a multi-scale RVQGAN architecture. We observe that audio-specific mel-spectrogram objectives are ill-suited for kinematic signals; however, by replacing them with simple time-domain and non-mel spectral reconstruction losses, audio-codec-style models can autoencode actions with high fidelity without substantial architectural changes. NAC provides a compact, ordered token space via offset codebooks, enabling standard autoregressive policies to operate over short, structured sequences. Meanwhile, a Vocos-style decoder with an ISTFT head and adversarial discriminators recovers smooth, detailed trajectories. Across LIBERO-10, RoboMimic, and a suite of real-world manipulation tasks, NAC achieves lower reconstruction error and higher success rates than binning, FAST, and prior VQ-based tokenizers at comparable or better compression rates. These results demonstrate that repurposed neural audio codecs offer a strong, practical backbone for learned action tokenization in modern VLAs.
tldr: NAC repurposes neural audio codec architectures with multi-scale RVQGAN and tailored losses to tokenize continuous robot actions into compact, ordered discrete tokens, achieving lower reconstruction error and higher task success than prior action tokenizers.
tldr_zh: NAC 将神经音频编解码器架构与多尺度 RVQGAN 及定制损失函数用于机器人连续动作的离散化编码，生成紧凑有序的离散 tokens，在重建误差和任务成功率上优于现有动作分词器。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型依赖离散动作分词器来桥接连续机器人控制与自回归序列建模，然而现有分词器往往在压缩率、延迟与下游性能之间进行权衡。我们通过神经音频编解码器的视角重新审视这一设计——该结构采用带残差向量量化的卷积编码器-解码器架构，已成为音频基础模型的标准前端。受其成功启发，我们提出神经动作编解码器（NAC），将短程机器人动作轨迹视为多通道一维信号，并利用多尺度RVQGAN架构对其进行压缩。我们观察到，针对音频设计的梅尔频谱图目标函数不适用于运动学信号；然而，通过将其替换为简单的时域和非梅尔频谱重建损失，音频编解码器风格的模型无需大幅修改架构即可高保真地编码动作。NAC通过偏移码本提供紧凑有序的令牌空间，使标准自回归策略能够处理短结构化序列。同时，采用带有ISTFT头部和对抗判别器的Vocos风格解码器，可恢复平滑、细节丰富的轨迹。在LIBERO-10、RoboMimic及一系列真实操作任务中，NAC在达到相当或更优压缩率的同时，其重建误差和任务成功率均优于分箱法、FAST及先前基于VQ的分词器。这些结果表明，经过改造的神经音频编解码器为现代VLA中的学习型动作分词提供了强大且实用的基础架构。

title: FleetAgent: Teleoperation Assistant for Autonomous Fleets via Vectorized V2N Messages
summary: Large-scale autonomous fleets rely on teleoperation to resolve rare failures, yet streaming raw sensor data from many vehicles is costly, and remote operators can only monitor a limited number of vehicles at a time. We introduce FleetAgent, a cloud-hosted multimodal large language model (MLLM) assistant that consumes compact vectorized vehicle-to-network (V2N) messages, such as map elements, detected objects, and the ego planned path. It provides a structured natural-language response (including narration, explanation, and evaluation of the plan and scene), along with an intervention urgency score for operator prioritization. To make structured messages compatible with token-based MLLMs, we propose VecFormer, a vector-to-embedding interface with differentiable top-K context selection that bounds context length and GPU KV-cache growth, enabling more efficient batch processing, which is important under the context of cloud-hosted large-scale fleet management. We also construct VecEval, a nuScenes-derived dataset with paired human and synthetic imperfect plans and human-verified language labels, to facilitate the training and evaluation of our proposed system. Our proposed system can reduce uplink payload by up to 625 times compared with raw images and reduce KV-cache memory by 16.54 times compared with original text descriptions. On VecEval, FleetAgent improves Lingo-Judge score by 16.8% and reduces intervention failure rate by 19.9%, compared with Qwen2.5-VL-7B using language descriptions. These results demonstrate that FleetAgent can utilize compact structured V2N messaging to enable efficient, explainable teleoperation monitoring for autonomous fleets.
tldr: FleetAgent is a cloud-hosted MLLM assistant that uses compact vectorized V2N messages and a novel VecFormer interface to enable efficient, explainable teleoperation monitoring for large-scale autonomous fleets.
tldr_zh: FleetAgent是一种云托管的多模态大语言模型助手，利用紧凑的矢量化V2N消息和新型VecFormer接口，为大规模自动驾驶车队实现高效、可解释的远程操作监控。
summary_zh: 大规模自主车队依赖远程操作来处理罕见故障，但流式传输多辆车辆的原始传感器数据成本高昂，且远程操作员一次只能监控有限数量的车辆。我们提出FleetAgent，这是一种云端多模态大语言模型（MLLM）助手，它接收紧凑的矢量化车联网（V2N）消息（例如地图元素、检测到的物体及自车规划路径），并生成结构化的自然语言响应（包括对规划与场景的叙述、解释及评估），同时提供干预紧急度分数以帮助操作员确定优先级。为使结构化消息与基于令牌的MLLM兼容，我们提出VecFormer——一种矢量到嵌入的接口，通过可微分的top-K上下文选择来限制上下文长度和GPU KV缓存增长，从而在云端大规模车队管理的背景下实现更高效的批量处理。我们还构建了VecEval数据集——基于nuScenes衍生而来，包含人工与合成的不完美规划配对数据及人工验证的语言标签，以促进所提系统的训练与评估。与原始图像相比，所提系统可将上行链路有效载荷降低高达625倍；与原始文本描述相比，KV缓存内存减少16.54倍。在VecEval上，与使用语言描述的Qwen2.5-VL-7B相比，FleetAgent的Lingo-Judge评分提升16.8%，干预失败率降低19.9%。这些结果表明，FleetAgent能够利用紧凑的结构化V2N消息，为自主车队实现高效且可解释的远程操作监控。

title: Remember what you did?: Learning Behavioral Memories for Partially Observable Object Manipulation
summary: Long horizon, contact-rich manipulation is inherently partially observable. This is as a single visual observation rarely captures a robot's full action context, including prior attempts, interactions, or progress. Consequently, standard visuomotor policies or vision-language-action models are prone to struggle in such tasks due to a lack of memory. To address this, we introduce Compressed Action Memory Policy (CAMP) based on the insight that a robot's own action history serves as a highly informative, self-supervised signal, enabling the policy to learn a robust, compact history representation. In our approach, we train a memory module to maintain a compressed representation of past actions, forcing it to encode a latent behavioral memory of all the robot's past interactions that can then be used to better contextualize future actions. This allows our approach to implicitly track generalized task progress and learn from failed attempts without any additional supervision, or external oversight. We evaluate CAMP across four real-robot setups and two novel simulation benchmarks: Memory-T-Bench and Memory-Manip-Bench. By demonstrating substantial gains over state-of-the-art baselines, CAMP is, to our knowledge, the first policy to demonstrate substantial success on contact-rich partially observable manipulation tasks purely through learned memory.
tldr: CAMP learns a compressed memory of past robot actions to handle long-horizon, partially observable manipulation tasks, achieving substantial gains over state-of-the-art baselines on real and simulated benchmarks.
tldr_zh: CAMP通过学习压缩的机器人历史动作记忆，来处理长时域、部分可观测的操纵任务，在真实和仿真基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 长时域、富含接触的操作任务本质上是部分可观测的。这是因为单次视觉观测往往无法捕捉机器人的完整动作上下文，包括先前的尝试、交互或进度。因此，标准视觉运动策略或视觉-语言-动作模型因缺乏记忆而在此类任务中容易表现不佳。为解决这一问题，我们基于"机器人自身动作历史可作为高信息量、自监督信号"的洞察，提出了压缩动作记忆策略（CAMP），使策略能够学习鲁棒且紧凑的历史表征。在该方法中，我们训练一个记忆模块来维护过去动作的压缩表征，迫使其编码所有机器人历史交互的潜在行为记忆，从而为后续动作提供更好的上下文。这使得我们的方法能够隐式追踪广义任务进度，并从失败尝试中学习，而无需任何额外监督或外部干预。我们在四种真实机器人平台和两个新型仿真基准（Memory-T-Bench与Memory-Manip-Bench）上评估了CAMP。通过展示相较于现有最优基线的显著性能提升，据我们所知，CAMP是首个仅通过习得记忆便在富含接触的部分可观测操作任务中取得显著成功的策略。

title: OmniV2X: A Generative Foundation Planner for Efficient End-to-End Cooperative Driving
summary: We present OmniV2X, a generative foundation model for vehicle-to-everything (V2X) cooperative driving. The model directly interprets independent context sequences comprising multi-modal and multi-agent observations. The new design mitigates the computational cost of dense 3D perception, the vulnerability to data scarcity in cooperative scenarios, and the poor compliance with standardized messaging in existing methods that fuse multi-modal inputs into a shared representation. For training, we present an end-to-end supervised pipeline using a downstream trajectory generation loss, in which a high-capacity generative sequence planner implicitly learns to steer the model and leverage multi-modal inputs via cross-attention injection. As a foundation model, we demonstrate that OmniV2X pre-trained on large-scale single-agent planning datasets can efficiently adapt to cooperative environments by integrating the conditioning context with lightweight, standard-compliant V2X tokens. Evaluated on the DAIR-V2X-Seq dataset, OmniV2X outperforms existing end-to-end cooperative driving baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance with less than 10% of the fine-tune V2X dataset and less than 1% of the communication bandwidth. We conduct comprehensive evaluations to demonstrate its computational efficiency and robustness under real-world constraints.
tldr: OmniV2X is a generative foundation model for end-to-end cooperative driving that uses a sequence planner with trajectory generation loss, enabling efficient fine-tuning with minimal V2X data and bandwidth while achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: OmniV2X是一个用于端到端协同驾驶的生成式基础模型，通过序列规划器和轨迹生成损失，在极少V2X数据和带宽下实现高效微调并达到最优性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
我们提出OmniV2X，一种面向车联万物（V2X）协同驾驶的生成式基础模型。该模型直接解析包含多模态与多智能体观测的独立上下文序列。其新颖设计缓解了现有方法中融合多模态输入为统一表征时存在的以下问题：密集三维感知的高计算成本、协同场景下对数据稀缺的脆弱性，以及对标准化消息的合规性不足。训练方面，我们提出一种采用下游轨迹生成损失的端到端监督流程，其中高容量生成式序列规划器通过交叉注意力注入隐式学习引导模型并利用多模态输入。作为基础模型，我们证明在大规模单智能体规划数据集上预训练的OmniV2X，通过将条件上下文与轻量化、符合标准的V2X令牌相结合，能够高效适配协同环境。在DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上的评估显示，OmniV2X仅需不到10%的微调V2X数据集及不到1%的通信带宽，便超越了现有端到端协同驾驶基线，达到最先进性能。我们开展了全面评估以证明其在真实约束下的计算效率与鲁棒性。

title: PoLAR: Factorizing Extent and Mode in Latent Actions for Robot Policy Learning
summary: Latent action pretraining learns representations of visual change from pairs of observations, but existing methods typically encode each transition as a single unstructured representation that entangles transition extent and transition mode. We introduce Polar Latent Actions with Radial structure (PoLAR), which imposes a radial-direction structure on latent actions, encouraging radius to encode transition extent and direction to retain transition mode. PoLAR uses temporal offset between two observations as a weak proxy for transition extent, encouraging latent action from observation pairs separated by larger temporal gaps to occupy larger radii. We instantiate this structure in hyperbolic space, whose expanding volume with radius offers a natural fit for more diverse transition modes at larger extents. Across in-task and large-scale pretraining settings, PoLAR improves downstream policy performance in simulation and real-world robot experiments, outperforming latent action baselines and strong pretrained VLAs. These results suggest that the geometry of the latent action space is an important design choice for transferring visual pretraining to downstream robot policy learning.
tldr: Proposes PoLAR, a latent action representation with radial-direction structure to disentangle transition extent and mode, improving robot policy learning in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 提出PoLAR，一种具有径向-方向结构的潜在动作表示，以解耦转换幅度和模式，在仿真和真实机器人实验中提升策略学习。
summary_zh: 潜在动作预训练通过观察对学习视觉变化的表征，但现有方法通常将每次状态转移编码为单一的非结构化表征，混淆了转移幅度与转移模式。我们提出具有径向结构的极坐标潜在动作（PoLAR），该方法在潜在动作上施加径向方向结构，促使半径编码转移幅度、方向保留转移模式。PoLAR利用两个观察之间的时间偏移作为转移幅度的弱代理指标，使得时间间隔较大的观察对产生的潜在动作占据更大的半径。我们在双曲空间中实例化该结构，其随半径扩张的容量天然适配于更大幅度下更多样化的转移模式。在任务内和大规模预训练场景中，PoLAR在仿真与真实机器人实验中均提升了下游策略性能，超越了潜在动作基线方法与强预训练视觉-语言-动作模型。这些结果表明，潜在动作空间的几何结构是将视觉预训练迁移至下游机器人策略学习的重要设计选择。

title: Factor-Aware Mixture-of-Experts with Pretrained Encoder for Combinatorial Generalization
summary: The integration of pretrained encoders with diffusion policies has become a dominant paradigm for visual robotic manipulation. However, it still struggles to generalize across complex environments with varying factors such as lighting and surface textures. To address this, we propose FAME, a framework that integrates a factor-aware mixture-of-experts (MoE) with a pretrained encoder to enhance generalization to environmental variations. FAME follows a three-stage training process: (1) policy warmup, where a diffusion policy is trained on standard-environment data with a frozen encoder; (2) factor-specific adapter training, where lightweight adapters inserted between the frozen encoder and the temporarily frozen policy are trained on customized datasets, each targeting a distinct environmental variation; and (3) joint fine-tuning, where a central router and the warmed policy are trained on mixed data to handle multiple factors jointly. FAME is ``factor-aware'' because the central router softly weights frozen factor-specific adapters as a dense MoE, enabling combinatorial generalization across multiple factors. Evaluations on the Meta-World benchmark show that FAME outperforms diffusion policy baselines by 34%. We further validate FAME in a real-world pick-and-place task using a compact model trained on newly collected data, where FAME achieves a 35% improvement in generalization under real-world variations.
tldr: FAME introduces a factor-aware mixture-of-experts framework with a pretrained encoder to improve combinatorial generalization of diffusion policies across environmental variations in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: FAME提出了一种因子感知的混合专家框架，结合预训练编码器，增强了扩散策略在机器人操作中对环境变化的组合泛化能力。
summary_zh: 预训练编码器与扩散策略的结合已成为视觉机器人操作的主流范式。然而，面对光照、表面纹理等可变因素构成的复杂环境，该方法仍难以实现泛化。为此，我们提出FAME框架，该框架将因子感知的混合专家模型与预训练编码器相结合，以增强对环境变化的泛化能力。FAME采用三阶段训练流程：（1）策略预热——在标准环境数据上使用冻结编码器训练扩散策略；（2）因子专用适配器训练——在冻结编码器与临时冻结策略之间插入轻量适配器，针对各自定制的数据集进行训练，每个数据集对应一种特定环境变化；（3）联合微调——在混合数据上训练中央路由器和预热策略，以联合处理多种因子。FAME的"因子感知"特性源于中央路由器以密集混合专家模型方式对冻结的因子专用适配器进行软加权，从而实现对多因子的组合泛化。在Meta-World基准上的评估表明，FAME相比扩散策略基线性能提升34%。我们进一步在真实世界的拾放任务中验证了FAME——使用新采集数据训练的紧凑模型，在真实环境变化下实现了35%的泛化性能提升。

title: MV-WAM: Manifold-Aware World Action Model with Value Augmentation
summary: Achieving robust and generalizable manipulation across diverse environments remains a fundamental challenge in embodied robotics. Recent world action models achieve strong in-domain performance, yet their gains do not extend proportionally to out-of-distribution scenarios. We attribute this to a structural mismatch between visual and action modalities, whose intrinsically heterogeneous manifolds cause joint optimization to disproportionately degrade action robustness under distribution shift. To address this, we propose MV-WAM, a novel end-to-end framework that jointly models visual prediction, action generation, and value estimation designed to effectively leverage video priors during both training and inference for enhanced action generalization. Key to this unification is a cross-modality causal mask that hierarchically grounds actions in predicted video frames and value function tokens in both modalities. To further narrow the generalization gap, MV-WAM adopts a manifold-aware optimization scheme that explicitly accounts for the structural heterogeneity across modalities. Finally, MV-WAM introduces a progress-value regulation mechanism that estimates task completion and detects misalignment between predicted frames and generated actions, enabling the policy to autonomously identify execution deviations and recover through value-guided rollback. On the RoboTwin simulation, MV-WAM achieves a 55.7% mean success rate on random scenarios without any randomized action supervision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 29.3%. MV-WAM achieves a 77.5% mean success rate across four real-world tasks of varying difficulty on a dual-arm robot. Our results demonstrate that manifold-aware cross-modal alignment is essential for robust policy generalization, offering a path toward deployable robotic manipulation.
tldr: MV-WAM proposes a manifold-aware cross-modal optimization and a progress-value regulation mechanism to jointly model visual prediction, action generation, and value estimation for robust robot manipulation generalization.
tldr_zh: MV-WAM 提出了一种流形感知的跨模态优化与进度-价值调节机制，联合建模视觉预测、动作生成和价值估计，以提升机器人操作的鲁棒泛化能力。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在不同环境中实现鲁棒且可泛化的操作，仍是具身机器人领域的一项基本挑战。近期世界行动模型在领域内任务上表现强劲，但其性能提升无法成比例地推广到分布外场景。我们将此归因于视觉与行动模态之间的结构性不匹配，其固有的异质性流形导致联合优化在分布偏移下不成比例地削弱了动作鲁棒性。为解决这一问题，我们提出MV-WAM——一种新颖的端到端框架，联合建模视觉预测、动作生成与价值估计，旨在训练和推理过程中有效利用视频先验以增强动作泛化能力。该统一框架的核心是一种跨模态因果掩码，它层次化地将动作锚定于预测视频帧中，并将价值函数令牌锚定于两种模态中。为进一步缩小泛化差距，MV-WAM采用了一种流形感知优化方案，显式考虑了各模态间的结构异质性。最后，MV-WAM引入了一种进度-价值调节机制，用于估计任务完成度并检测预测帧与生成动作之间的失配，从而使策略能够自主识别执行偏差并通过价值引导回滚进行恢复。在RoboTwin仿真中，MV-WAM在无需任何随机动作监督的随机场景下实现了55.7%的平均成功率，比最强基线高出29.3%。在双机械臂上，MV-WAM在四个难度各异的真实世界任务中实现了77.5%的平均成功率。我们的结果表明，流形感知的跨模态对齐对于鲁棒策略泛化至关重要，为可部署的机器人操作提供了一条可行路径。

title: BayesFP: Posterior Estimation for Flow-Based Policies via Feynman-Kac Sampling
summary: Robots must generate trajectories that remain faithful to learned expert behavior while satisfying safety constraints and task-specific objectives specified only at inference time. We formulate constrained trajectory generation for pretrained diffusion and flow-matching policies as Bayesian posterior sampling, with the learned demonstration distribution as a prior and an inference-time, cost-derived likelihood tilting it toward feasible, optimal trajectories. To sample from this posterior without any retraining of the base policy, we leverage the Feynman--Kac corrector framework, originally formulated for diffusion models, and extend it to deterministic flow-matching policies. The result is a unified, inference-time, retraining-free sampler for diffusion and flow policies. We validate the approach on pretrained Diffusion Policy, GR00T-N1.6, and $π_{0.5}$ checkpoints across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, including planning around non-convex obstacles introduced at inference time, and show improvements over the base $π_{0.5}$ on zero-shot tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces a retraining-free, inference-time sampling method for constrained trajectory generation from pretrained diffusion and flow-matching policies, treating the learned distribution as a prior and task costs as a likelihood for Bayesian posterior sampling. It extends the Feynman-Kac corrector framework to flow matching and demonstrates improved zero-shot performance on real-world manipulation tasks using checkpoints like Diffusion Policy, GR00T-N1.6, and π0.5.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无需重新训练、仅在推理时采样的方法，用于从预训练的扩散和流匹配策略中生成受约束的轨迹；它将学习到的分布视为先验，任务成本视为似然，进行贝叶斯后验采样。论文将费曼-卡克校正器框架扩展到流匹配，并在使用 Diffusion Policy、GR00T-N1.6 和 π0.5 等检查点的真实世界操作任务上展示了改进的零样本性能。
summary_zh: 机器人必须生成既忠实于学习到的专家行为，又满足推理阶段指定的安全约束与任务特定目标的轨迹。我们将预训练扩散模型与流匹配策略的约束轨迹生成问题建模为贝叶斯后验采样，其中学习到的示范分布作为先验，推理阶段基于代价的似然函数将其向可行且最优的轨迹倾斜。为在不重新训练基础策略的情况下从该后验分布中采样，我们借鉴了最初为扩散模型设计的费曼-卡克校正器框架，并将其扩展至确定性流匹配策略。由此形成了针对扩散策略与流策略的统一推理阶段免重训练采样器。我们在预训练的Diffusion Policy、GR00T-N1.6及$π_{0.5}$检查点上进行了验证，涵盖仿真与真实世界的操作任务（包括在推理阶段引入的非凸障碍物周围的规划），并展示了在零样本任务中相较于基础$π_{0.5}$的改进效果。

title: Inductive Generalization for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Understanding the generalization capabilities of visuomotor policies is essential in the development of capable robotic agents. Generalizable models learn structures that transfer across domains. However, in practice, visuomotor policies test performance by interpolation on known distributions using unstructured domain shifts (e.g. lighting, clutter, diverse objects). We argue that to measure generalization capabilities we must instead test the inductive capacity of policies on progressively harder, out-of-distribution task variants. We call this inductive generalization, drawing directly on how axis-based evaluation has revealed inherent generalization limitations in language models (e.g. sequence length, counting) arXiv:2502.00197 . We provide a reusable and formal evaluation protocol for measuring inductive generalization in any manipulation policy, and establish baselines showing that existing paradigms fail this test; e.g. SoTA Vision-Language-Action models and find that policies that appear to generalize to prior domain shifts (distractors, etc) fail inductive generalization tests. These results expose a class of learning challenges orthogonal to those addressed by data and model scaling in robot learning, yet are imperative to solve in order to realize general purpose robots.
tldr: This paper introduces 'inductive generalization' as a formal evaluation protocol that tests manipulation policies on progressively harder out-of-distribution task variants, revealing that current vision-language-action models fail these tests despite appearing robust to standard domain shifts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种“归纳泛化”的正式评估协议，测试操作策略在逐步困难的分布外任务变体上的表现，发现当前的视觉-语言-动作模型虽然能应对标准领域变化，但在这些测试中失败。
summary_zh: 理解视觉运动策略的泛化能力对于开发高性能机器人智能体至关重要。可泛化模型能够学习跨域迁移的结构。然而在实践中，视觉运动策略通过使用非结构化域偏移（如光照、杂乱场景、多样化物体）对已知分布进行插值来测试性能。我们认为，要衡量泛化能力，必须转而测试策略在逐步变难的、分布外任务变体上的归纳能力。我们将此称为归纳泛化，直接借鉴了基于轴的评估如何揭示语言模型（如序列长度、计数）中固有的泛化局限（arXiv:2502.00197）。我们提出了一种可重复使用且形式化的评估协议，用于衡量任何操作策略中的归纳泛化能力，并建立了基准，表明现有范式无法通过该测试。例如，对SoTA视觉-语言-动作模型的研究发现，那些看似在先前域偏移（干扰物等）上表现出泛化的策略，在归纳泛化测试中却失败了。这些结果揭示了一类学习挑战，其与机器人学习中数据和模型扩展所解决的问题正交，但若要实现通用机器人，则必须解决这些挑战。

title: Duet: Dual-Robot Understanding via Efficient Teaching
summary: Dual-robot collaboration enables tasks that exceed the reach and payload of a single robot, such as collaboratively transporting objects across environments and executing coordinated handovers. Data acquisition is the primary bottleneck for training these systems. To this end, we introduce DUET, a dual-robot learning framework for mobile manipulation. For efficient data collection, we create a unified dual-embodiment synchronized VR-based teleoperation system for in-domain heterogeneous robot data collection. We further develop a complementary tracking pipeline that records human-human coordination and collaborative mobile manipulation priors. To allow efficient learning, we introduce an Action Chunking Transformer based architecture that first pretrains collaborative policies on efficient human-human demonstrations, before finetuning them on a minimal set of real-robot teleoperation trajectories. We develop a benchmark of four collaborative tasks to evaluate our framework using a Unitree G1 humanoid and a Dexmate Vega1 mobile manipulator. The results demonstrate that harnessing human priors not only yields superior task performance compared to baselines trained only on robot data, but also reduces the total human effort required for data collection. Our human data collection pipeline achieves 5.4x acceleration on average from teleoperation, but we perform equally or better than robot-only data trained policies across all tasks. Our project page is available at https://zhaoy37.github.io/Duet/.
tldr: DUET introduces a dual-robot learning framework for mobile manipulation that leverages efficient human-human demonstration data and minimal real-robot teleoperation to train collaborative policies, achieving superior task performance with reduced human effort.
tldr_zh: DUET提出了一种双机器人移动操作学习框架，利用高效的人-人协作演示数据和少量真实遥控操作数据训练协作策略，在减少人力需求的同时实现了更优的任务性能。
summary_zh: 双机器人协作能够完成超出单机器人的操作范围与负载能力的任务，例如跨环境协同搬运物体以及执行协调交接。数据采集是训练此类系统的主要瓶颈。为此，我们提出DUET——一种面向移动操作的双机器人学习框架。为实现高效数据采集，我们构建了统一的、基于同步VR遥操作的双形态异构机器人数据采集系统。同时，我们开发了互补的跟踪流程，用于记录人-人协作与协同移动操作先验知识。为实现高效学习，我们引入基于动作分块Transformer的架构，该架构首先在高效的人-人示范数据上预训练协作策略，随后在最小规模的真实机器人遥操作轨迹数据集上进行微调。我们设计了包含四项协作任务的基准测试，使用Unitree G1人形机器人与Dexmate Vega1移动操作机器人评估该框架。结果表明，相比于仅依赖机器人数据训练的基线，利用人类先验知识不仅能获得更优的任务性能，还能减少数据采集所需的人类总工作量。与仅使用机器人数据训练的策略相比，我们的数据采集流程在遥操作阶段平均实现5.4倍加速，且在所有任务中性能持平或更优。项目页面：https://zhaoy37.github.io/Duet/。

title: Vesta: A Generalist Embodied Reasoning Model
summary: Robots operating in open-world environments must seamlessly integrate localization, spatial reasoning, navigation, and long-horizon planning. While specialist models excel at individual tasks, deploying a multi-model stack is computationally expensive and prone to cascading errors. We present Vesta, a unified embodied generalist that consolidates these capabilities into a single foundation model. Our approach combines a diverse and massive curated corpus designed to induce spatial grounding and a simple multimodal memory harness that enables reasoning over extended time horizons. Across diverse benchmarks, Vesta on average beats individual SOTA baselines by >$20\%$ and beats an ensemble of per-category-best baselines by $>10\%$ -- thus demonstrating that a generalist model can match or exceed specialists. On real-world robotic tasks requiring memory and reasoning, Vesta improves task success by >35\%. Our work thus demonstrates that a single generalist is a feasible, scalable, and arguably preferable alternative to combining specialists.
tldr: Vesta is a unified embodied generalist model that combines localization, spatial reasoning, navigation, and long-horizon planning into a single foundation model, outperforming specialist models across diverse benchmarks and real-world robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: Vesta是一个统一的具身通用模型，将定位、空间推理、导航和长时程规划整合到单个基础模型中，在多种基准测试和真实机器人任务上超越了专家模型。
summary_zh: 在开放世界环境中运行的机器人必须无缝整合定位、空间推理、导航与长时域规划。尽管专家模型在单项任务中表现出色，但部署多模型堆栈不仅计算成本高昂，还容易产生级联误差。本文提出Vesta——一个统一的具身通用模型，将上述能力整合到单一基础模型中。我们的方法结合了经过精心设计的大规模多样化语料库（旨在诱发空间基础能力）与一个简单的多模态记忆框架（支持长时域推理）。在多个基准测试中，Vesta平均超越各单项任务最先进的基线模型超过20%，并比按类别最优基线集成的模型高出10%以上——这表明通用模型能够达到甚至超过专家模型。在需要记忆与推理能力的真实世界机器人任务中，Vesta将任务成功率提升了超过35%。因此，我们的工作证明：单一通用模型是组合专家模型的一种可行、可扩展且更具优势的替代方案。

title: SignVLA: Real-Time Sign Language-Guided Robotic Manipulation via Attention LSTM and Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to execute manipulation tasks from natural-language instructions grounded in visual observations. However, existing VLA interfaces primarily rely on speech or text input, limiting accessibility for deaf, hard-of-hearing, and speech-impaired users. We present SignVLA, a real-time sign-language-guided VLA framework for accessible human-robot interaction. The system introduces a modular sign-to-text interface that converts visual sign gestures into semantic instructions compatible with downstream VLA policies. Given video streams, SignVLA extracts hand landmark features and employs an attention-enhanced Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal gesture dynamics for alphabet- and command-level sign recognition. A temporal stabilization module further improves prediction consistency in real-time interaction settings.The generated instruction sequence is then passed to a downstream VLA policy for sign-conditioned robotic manipulation. Experimental results demonstrate stable real-time sign recognition and successful execution of manipulation tasks driven by sign-language inputs. Our findings suggest that lightweight temporal sign recognition can serve as an effective and practical accessibility layer for multimodal embodied intelligence.
tldr: SignVLA integrates a lightweight attention-LSTM sign language recognizer with a downstream VLA policy to enable real-time, sign-language-driven robotic manipulation, improving accessibility for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.
tldr_zh: SignVLA 将轻量级注意力LSTM手语识别器与下游VLA策略相结合，实现实时手语驱动的机器人操作，为听障用户提供无障碍交互接口。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使机器人能够基于视觉观测中的自然语言指令执行操作任务。然而，现有VLA接口主要依赖语音或文本输入，限制了失聪、听障及言语障碍用户的可及性。我们提出SignVLA——一种用于无障碍人机交互的实时手语引导VLA框架。该系统引入模块化的手语转文本接口，将视觉手势转换为与下游VLA策略兼容的语义指令。给定视频流后，SignVLA提取手部关键点特征，并采用注意力增强的长短期记忆（LSTM）网络捕捉时间维度上的手势动态，实现字母级和指令级手语识别。一个时间稳定化模块进一步提升了实时交互场景下的预测一致性。生成的指令序列随后被传递至下游VLA策略，以执行手语条件化的机器人操作任务。实验结果表明，该系统能够实现稳定的实时手语识别，并成功执行由手语输入驱动的操作任务。本研究揭示，轻量级时间手势识别可作为多模态具身智能的有效且实用的无障碍接入层。

title: FAST: A Framework for Aligned Sampling and Training in Parallel Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Deep reinforcement learning is pivotal for closed-loop autonomous driving yet remains constrained by severe bottlenecks in sampling efficiency. Standard parallel sampling mitigates this but suffers from the straggler effect, where the premature termination of a single environment necessitates a synchronized batch re-initialization, leading to suboptimal sample utilization and prohibitive re-initialization latency. To address this, we propose FAST, a synchronous parallel framework tailored for closed-loop simulation. Specifically, FAST employs Dynamic Parallel Sampling Alignment (DPSA) to maintain vectorization synchronization by extending terminated episodes via virtual continuation, thereby decoupling the sampling loop from individual terminations. By dynamically triggering global truncation based on the termination rate of parallel clips, FAST effectively eliminates the bottleneck of premature resets without sacrificing data diversity. Furthermore, to strictly preserve theoretical consistency, we incorporate a Scaled Mask-Padding Optimization (SMPO) that leverages validity masking and adaptive loss normalization to nullify the bias from auxiliary padding data. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that FAST achieves at least a 1.78 times wall-clock speedup over the single-clip baseline while preserving statistical unbiasedness.
tldr: FAST proposes a synchronous parallel reinforcement learning framework with dynamic sampling alignment and scaled mask-padding optimization to eliminate the straggler effect in closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, achieving speedup while preserving statistical unbiasedness.
tldr_zh: FAST 提出了一种同步并行强化学习框架，通过动态采样对齐和缩放掩码填充优化消除了闭环自动驾驶模拟中的落伍者效应，在保持统计无偏性的同时实现了加速。
summary_zh: 深度强化学习是闭环自动驾驶的关键技术，但其采样效率始终面临严重瓶颈。标准并行采样方法虽能缓解该问题，却受困于掉队效应——单个环境的提前终止会迫使整批环境同步重新初始化，导致采样利用率低下且重初始化延迟过高。针对这一挑战，我们提出FAST框架，一种专为闭环仿真设计的同步并行架构。具体而言，FAST通过动态并行采样对齐（DPSA）机制，利用虚拟延续扩展已终止轨迹以维持向量化同步，从而将采样循环与单个环境终止解耦。进一步地，通过基于并行片段终止率动态触发全局截断，FAST在不牺牲数据多样性的前提下有效消除了提前重置的瓶颈。为确保理论严格一致性，我们引入缩放掩码填充优化（SMPO），利用有效性掩码与自适应损失归一化消除辅助填充数据带来的偏差。实验评估表明，FAST在保持统计无偏性的同时，相比单片段基线实现了至少1.78倍的物理时间加速。

title: VLA-FAIL: Efficient Task Failure Detection for Finetuned Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on many robotic manipulation tasks, yet they can still behave unpredictably in out-of-distribution scenarios. Runtime failure detection is therefore essential for the safe real-world deployment of VLAs. However, existing task failure detectors require computationally expensive action sampling, are based on architectural assumptions that limit their applicability to VLAs, or need access to failure rollouts. We propose VLA-FAIL, a lightweight and broadly applicable failure detection framework for VLAs that combines two novel failure detectors with minimal overhead, without requiring failure data. The first, last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD), detects out-of-distribution states by measuring token-wise deviations in last-layer features relative to the training data. The second, action chunk consistency (ACC), exploits the temporal overlap induced by receding-horizon control and detects failures when consecutive action chunks become inconsistent. To capture the trade-off between detection accuracy and detection latency, we introduce AUCPDT, a threshold-independent metric that jointly evaluates precision, recall, and detection time. Through extensive real-world and simulation experiments, we demonstrate that LLMD and ACC capture complementary failure modes whose combination enables reliable and early failure detection across diverse tasks, frequently outperforming significantly more expensive baseline methods.
tldr: Proposes two lightweight failure detectors (LLMD and ACC) for VLAs that require no failure data and minimal overhead, achieving reliable real-world failure detection.
tldr_zh: 提出了两种轻量级VLA故障检测器（LLMD和ACC），无需故障数据且开销极小，在真实场景中实现可靠的故障检测。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在多种机器人操作任务中实现了最先进的性能，但在分布外场景下仍可能出现不可预测的行为。因此，运行时故障检测对于VLA在现实世界中的安全部署至关重要。然而，现有任务故障检测方法要么需要计算昂贵的动作采样，要么基于架构假设而限制了其在VLA中的适用性，要么需要访问故障演示数据。我们提出VLA-FAIL，一种轻量级且广泛适用的VLA故障检测框架，结合了两种新型故障检测器，在无需故障数据的前提下实现最小化额外开销。第一种方法——末层马氏距离（LLMD），通过测量末层特征中相对于训练数据的令牌级偏差来检测分布外状态。第二种方法——动作片段一致性（ACC），利用滚动时域控制带来的时间重叠特性，在连续动作片段出现不一致时检测故障。为捕捉检测准确率与检测延迟之间的权衡，我们引入AUCPDT这一无阈值的指标，可联合评估精确率、召回率和检测时间。通过大量真实世界与仿真实验，我们证明LLMD和ACC能够捕捉互补的故障模式，其组合可在多样化任务中实现可靠且早期的故障检测，其性能通常显著优于成本更高的基线方法。

title: Overcoming Imperfect Kinematics in Surgical Robotics Through Sim-to-Real Visuomotor Learning
summary: Robot-Assisted Surgery is integral to modern minimally invasive procedures, with automation emerging as the next frontier to enhance precision and reduce surgeon fatigue. This evolution is largely impeded by the inherent kinematic inaccuracies of surgical robots, where unreliable internal sensors lead to significant control errors. While previous methods attempted to mitigate these issues through complex model-based calibration, they often suffer from high cost and limited effectiveness. This work utilises a learning-policy to actively compensate for hardware inaccuracies using closed-loop visual feedback that was trained from a teacher-student learning framework. The policy can fuse unreliable internal readings with precise external visual data, allowing it to correct for kinematic errors in real time without needing a perfect physical model. The learned policy was successfully deployed on the da Vinci Research Kit, where experiments validated the fundamental feasibility of using external vision to overcome internal sensor deficits. This research provides a foundational and reliable control methodology, paving the way for more advanced and robust surgical automation.
tldr: This paper proposes a visuomotor learning policy that compensates for kinematic inaccuracies in surgical robots by fusing unreliable internal sensor readings with precise external visual feedback, trained via a teacher-student framework and deployed on the da Vinci Research Kit.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种视觉运动学习策略，通过教师-学生框架训练，融合不可靠的内部传感器数据与精确的外部视觉反馈，实时补偿手术机器人的运动学误差，并在达芬奇研究套件上成功部署。
summary_zh: 机器人辅助手术是现代微创手术的核心组成部分，而自动化正成为提升精度、减少外科医生疲劳的下一个前沿方向。这一发展进程在很大程度上受到手术机器人固有运动学误差的阻碍——其内部传感器不可靠，导致显著的控制误差。以往的方法尝试通过基于模型的复杂标定来缓解这些问题，但往往存在成本高昂、效果有限等缺陷。本研究利用一种从师生学习框架中训练得到的学习策略，借助闭环视觉反馈主动补偿硬件误差。该策略能够融合不可靠的内部读数与精确的外部视觉数据，从而无需完美物理模型即可实时校正运动学误差。该学习策略已成功部署在达芬奇研究套件上，实验验证了利用外部视觉克服内部传感器缺陷的基本可行性。本研究提供了一种基础且可靠的控制方法，为更先进、更稳健的手术自动化系统奠定了基础。

title: Long-Distance Real-World Navigation of the Legged-Wheeled Robot Go2-W Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Legged-wheeled robots have long been studied for their potential to combine the efficient flat-ground mobility of wheels with the rough-terrain capability of legs. However, examples of their application to long-range autonomous navigation in real environments remain limited. This paper reports our effort to build a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based locomotion controller and an autonomous navigation system for the commercially available legged-wheeled robot Go2-W, and to apply them to long-range autonomous navigation in a real environment. For locomotion control, we extended a proprioception-only policy, which we had previously developed for quadruped robots, to the 16-DoF legged-wheeled robot. We also found that wheeled locomotion concentrates the load on the hip joints and causes heat concentration that hinders sustained travel, and obtained a policy that suppresses it by distributing the load. We evaluated the system at the Tsukuba Challenge 2025, demonstrating that it can autonomously traverse an approximately 2.8 km route including sidewalks, a park, and stairs without stopping due to overheating.
tldr: This paper presents a DRL-based locomotion controller and autonomous navigation system for the Go2-W legged-wheeled robot, achieving 2.8 km real-world autonomous navigation including stairs without overheating.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了基于深度强化学习的Go2-W轮腿机器人运动控制器和自主导航系统，在真实环境中实现了2.8公里的自主导航，包括楼梯等复杂地形，且未发生过热问题。
summary_zh: 腿轮机器人因其结合轮式高效平坦地面机动性与腿部崎岖地形适应能力的潜力而受到长期研究。然而，其在真实环境中进行长距离自主导航的应用实例仍然有限。本文报告了我们为商用腿轮机器人Go2-W构建基于深度强化学习的运动控制器与自主导航系统，并将其应用于真实环境长距离自主导航的研究工作。在运动控制方面，我们将先前为四足机器人开发的仅基于本体感受的控制策略扩展至16自由度腿轮机器人。我们还发现，轮式运动将负载集中于髋关节，导致热量集中而阻碍持续行进，并通过负载分配抑制了该问题的策略。我们在2025年筑波挑战赛中对该系统进行了评估，证明了其能够自主穿越包含人行道、公园和楼梯的约2.8公里路线，且未因过热而中断。

title: Mind the Noise: Sensitivity of Transformer-based Interaction-Aware Trajectory Prediction Models to Noisy Data
summary: Trajectory prediction allows autonomous vehicles to anticipate the future behavior of surrounding objects (or agents) and, accordingly, maximize the safety and efficiency of their driving. State-of-the-art Transformed-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models, which rely on attention mechanisms to capture multi-agent interactions and maximize prediction accuracy, are commonly trained and evaluated on long-range high-quality datasets. These datasets are typically obtained by aggregating data from multiple vehicles or drones and removing any object detection or tracking noise offline. Yet, information about a surrounding object's state (its position, speed, heading) is far from being noiseless in real-world deployments. Object state estimation is affected by perception uncertainties and localization errors that can be particularly large for objects received via Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communications. In this paper, we analyze the impact of noisy object state information on the trajectory prediction accuracy of a state-of-the-art Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction model. Our study demonstrates that trajectory prediction accuracy can rapidly deteriorate as the noise intensity increases. Numerical results show that the prediction accuracy can reduce by a 1.3x factor under small noise levels and by as much as a 3.9x factor under the highest (yet realistic) noise conditions. These findings reveal the strong sensitivity of trajectory prediction models to noisy data, underscoring the need for more realistic training and evaluation datasets as well as noise mitigation strategies.
tldr: Analyzes the sensitivity of Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models to noisy object state data, showing that prediction accuracy degrades significantly under realistic noise levels.
tldr_zh: 分析了基于Transformer的交互感知轨迹预测模型对噪声目标状态数据的敏感性，表明在现实噪声条件下预测精度显著下降。
summary_zh: 轨迹预测使自动驾驶车辆能够预判周围物体（或智能体）的未来行为，从而最大化行驶安全性与效率。当前基于Transformer的交互感知轨迹预测模型（通过注意力机制捕捉多智能体交互并提升预测精度）通常依赖长距离高质量数据集进行训练与评估。此类数据集多由多车辆或无人机数据聚合而成，并离线消除物体检测或跟踪噪声。然而，在实际部署环境中，周围物体状态信息（位置、速度、航向角）远非无噪。物体状态估计受感知不确定性与定位误差影响，对通过车联网（V2X）通信获取的物体而言，此类误差尤为显著。本文分析了噪声物体状态信息对当前最先进的基于Transformer的交互感知轨迹预测模型精度的影响。研究表明，随着噪声强度增加，轨迹预测精度会迅速恶化。数值结果显示，在低噪声水平下预测精度下降1.3倍，而在最高（但实际可存在的）噪声条件下精度降幅可达3.9倍。这些发现揭示了轨迹预测模型对噪声数据的高度敏感性，凸显了构建更真实的训练与评估数据集以及发展噪声抑制策略的必要性。

title: A scalar per patch from pre-trained ViTs enables fast moving navigation in the real world
summary: Trained policies for real-world robotics rely on computer vision components, typically in the form of pre-trained visual encoders. These encoders are an essential component and it has been shown that their power does not emerge from training on robotics downstream losses alone. Pre-training with auxiliary losses in the form of computer-vision pre-text tasks is a defining factor and heavily conditions agent performance in robotics tasks. In this unprecedented large-scale study, we ran 966 navigation episodes of static point goal navigation in a real-world building for 24km and asked which components really matter for the computer vision aspects of robotics: we evaluate state-of-the art visual encoders in realistic conditions. We explore the usefulness of heterogeneous multi-teacher distillation leading to encoders with multiple different and complementary skills. We investigate how much information from these encoders is necessary for robotics by bottlenecking them in a principled and spatially useful way and we show that this leads to the emergence of interpretable features linked to affordances. We also argue that training policies on RGB data alone does not lead to an optimal usage of visual features and show this by finetuning policies pre-trained on privileged information. All in all, we paint a more complete picture of what aspects of computer vision are relevant for real-world navigation.
tldr: This paper conducts a large-scale real-world study of visual encoders for static point-goal navigation, evaluating distillations, bottlenecks, and privileged finetuning, showing that pre-trained ViT features can be spatially bottlenecked to a scalar per patch for fast navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文通过真实环境中的大规模导航实验（966次、24公里），研究了视觉编码器的关键设计因素，发现对ViT特征进行空间瓶颈处理（每个patch一个标量）可显著提升导航速度。
summary_zh: 针对真实世界机器人学的策略训练依赖计算机视觉组件，通常采用预训练视觉编码器的形式。这些编码器是关键组成部分，且研究表明其效力并非仅源于机器人学下游损失的训练。以计算机视觉前置任务形式进行的辅助损失预训练是一个决定性因素，在很大程度上影响着机器人在各项任务中的表现性能。在这项规模空前的研究中，我们在真实建筑环境中开展了966次静态点目标导航实验（总里程24公里），探究哪些组件对机器人学的计算机视觉环节真正重要：我们在真实条件下评估了最先进的视觉编码器。我们探索了异构多教师蒸馏的效用，该技术可生成具备多元互补技能的编码器。通过以原则性且保持空间信息有效性的方式对编码器进行瓶颈化处理，我们研究了这些编码器需提供多少信息才能满足机器人学需求，并证明该过程可催生与可交互性相关的可解释特征。此外，我们论证了仅基于RGB数据训练策略无法实现视觉特征的最优利用，并通过微调基于特权信息预训练的策略验证了这一观点。综上所述，我们更全面地呈现了计算机视觉中哪些方面对真实世界导航具有实际意义。

title: Pose-Agnostic Robotic Functional Grasping via Observation-Action Canonicalization
summary: Functional robotic grasping requires a policy that generalizes across diverse object geometries and poses while maintaining task-specific contact precision. We study this challenge through mug-handle grasping, where thin handles, instance variation, and upright or inverted placements make both perception and control sensitive to object configuration. Grasp pose detection methods operate open-loop and are sensitive to estimation errors on thin handle structures. Learned visuomotor policies must implicitly learn to handle the coupled variation in visual appearance and action direction induced by different object placements, limiting generalization. We propose AnyMug, a canonicalized visuomotor reinforcement learning framework for functional grasping that trains a single closed-loop policy entirely in simulation and deploys it zero-shot on a real robot. AnyMug introduces observation-action canonicalization, which transforms both the depth observation and the predicted end-effector action into a shared object-centric frame. The policy therefore sees a consistent mug-centered view and emits actions in a canonical direction regardless of mug placement, allowing the same grasping behavior to be reused across configurations. A handle-aware reward further encourages precise approach, gripper alignment, and opposing-finger placement, while a pose curriculum and domain randomization improve training stability and sim-to-real transfer. In simulation, AnyMug achieves over 93% success rate on both unseen upright and inverted mugs and transfers zero-shot to a real Franka Panda, reaching 80% success rate on 5 held-out physical mugs across both pose categories.
tldr: AnyMug proposes observation-action canonicalization to train a single visuomotor policy in simulation that generalizes zero-shot to real-world functional grasping of mugs in varied poses, achieving high success rates on upright and inverted mugs.
tldr_zh: AnyMug 提出了观察-动作规范化方法，在仿真中训练单一视觉运动策略，零样本迁移到真实世界，实现不同姿态（正置和倒置）杯子的功能性抓取，并取得高成功率。
summary_zh: 功能性机器人抓取需要一种策略，能够泛化至不同物体几何形状与姿态，同时保持任务特定的接触精度。我们通过杯柄抓取研究这一挑战：细手柄、实例变化以及直立或倒置放置方式，使得感知与控制均对物体构型高度敏感。抓取姿态检测方法以开环方式运行，且对细手柄结构上的估计误差敏感。学习型视觉运动策略需隐式处理不同物体放置所引发的视觉外观与动作方向的耦合变化，限制了泛化能力。我们提出AnyMug——一种用于功能性抓取的规范化视觉运动强化学习框架，该框架完全在仿真环境中训练单个闭环策略，并零样本部署至真实机器人。AnyMug引入观测-动作规范化，将深度观测与预测的末端执行器动作均变换至共享的物体中心坐标系。因此，策略能观察到一致的杯心视角，并沿规范化方向发出动作，无论杯体如何放置，均可复用相同的抓取行为。手柄感知奖励进一步促进精确接近、夹爪对齐及对指放置，而姿态课程与域随机化则提升训练稳定性及仿真到真实迁移效果。在仿真中，AnyMug对未见过的直立与倒置杯体均实现超93%成功率，并零样本迁移至真实Franka Panda机器人，在5个保留的实物杯体上针对两种姿态类别均达到80%成功率。

title: R2HandoverSim: A Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Robot-to-Human Object Handovers
summary: We present R2HandoverSim, a simulation benchmark for robot-to-human (R2H) object handovers. Although R2H handover methods have advanced rapidly, the lack of standardized evaluation protocols impedes objective comparison. Our benchmark enables reproducible evaluation by systematically comparing four baselines on their predicted shared grasp poses. We conduct a user study with 30 participants, analyze baseline performance, and show that simulation results correlate with real-world evaluation outcomes. Crucially, five complementary metrics (planning feasibility, reachability, grasp stability, grasp affordance, and safety) better reflect user-perceived handover quality than overall success rate alone. Website and code: https://robot-future.github.io/r2handoversim/.
tldr: Introduces a simulation benchmark with standardized metrics for robot-to-human object handovers, validated via a user study showing correlation between simulation and real-world performance.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个用于机器人到人类物体交接的仿真基准，通过标准化指标和用户研究验证了仿真结果与现实世界表现的相关性。
summary_zh: 我们提出了R2HandoverSim，一个用于机器人向人类（R2H）传递物体的仿真基准测试平台。尽管R2H传递方法已取得快速进展，但缺乏标准化的评估协议阻碍了客观比较。我们的基准测试通过系统比较四种基线方法在预测共享抓取姿态上的表现，实现了可重复的评估。我们开展了一项包含30名参与者的用户研究，分析了基线方法的性能，并表明仿真结果与现实世界的评估结果具有相关性。关键的是，五类互补性指标（规划可行性、可达性、抓取稳定性、抓取可用性和安全性）比仅仅使用整体成功率能更有效地反映用户感知的传递质量。网站及代码：https://robot-future.github.io/r2handoversim/。

title: Geometric Entropy: When Trajectory Diversity Helps and Hurts in Imitation Learning
summary: We study how trajectory-shape diversity in demonstrations affects imitation learning (IL) performance across models, tasks, and data scales. We introduce Geometric Entropy (H_G), a task-agnostic metric that quantifies the intrinsic diversity of transit trajectories after normalizing away extrinsic variation, such as goal pose and workspace scale, via target-frame alignment. Across multiple IL architectures and both simulated and real-robot contact-rich manipulation tasks, we observe a consistent inverted-U relationship between success and H_G: increasing geometric diversity improves robustness in low-diversity regimes but degrades performance once diversity induces strategy ambiguity. Moreover, the optimal entropy shifts toward lower values as task mastery increases through more data, easier tasks, or stronger priors, and for a pretrained vision-language-action model the trend becomes effectively monotonic decreasing. Practically, H_G enables fast pre-training auditing of demonstration datasets and offers a simple guideline for calibrating demonstrations toward the learnable regime.
tldr: This paper introduces Geometric Entropy (H_G), a task-agnostic metric for quantifying trajectory-shape diversity in demonstration data, and reveals an inverted-U relationship between H_G and imitation learning success across manipulation tasks, with optimal entropy decreasing as task mastery increases.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了几何熵（H_G），一种用于量化演示数据中轨迹形状多样性的任务无关指标，并揭示了在操作任务中H_G与模仿学习成功率之间的倒U型关系，随着任务熟练度的提高，最优熵值会降低。
summary_zh: 我们研究了演示中轨迹形状多样性如何影响不同模型、任务和数据规模下的模仿学习性能。我们提出几何熵（H_G）这一与任务无关的度量指标，通过目标框架对齐归一化掉目标姿态和工作空间规模等外在变异后，量化迁移轨迹的内在多样性。在多种模仿学习架构以及仿真与真实机器人接触式操作任务中，我们观察到成功率与H_G之间存在一致的倒U型关系：增加几何多样性可提升低多样性区域的鲁棒性，但当多样性引发策略模糊性时性能则会下降。此外，随着更多数据、更易任务或更强先验带来的任务掌握程度提升，最优熵值向更低数值偏移；对于预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型，该趋势实际上呈现单调递减。实际应用中，H_G能够实现演示数据集的快速预训练审计，并为将演示校准至可学习范围提供简便指导准则。

title: A DVDrive Approach for doScenes Instructed Driving Challenge
summary: Instruction-conditioned trajectory prediction is an emerging problem in autonomous driving, where a model predicts the future ego trajectory not only from visual scene context and historical motion, but also from a natural-language maneuver instruction. This paper presents our submission to the doScenes Instructed Driving Challenge, built upon OmniDrive, a vision-language-action driving agent with 3D perception, reasoning, and planning capabilities. We adapt OmniDrive to the doScenes setting by training it on instruction-annotated nuScenes scenes and generating a 6-second ego trajectory represented by 12 future waypoints. To improve multi-view visual grounding, we further introduce a DVPE-style divided-view perception module into the OmniDrive perception head. Instead of attending globally to all camera features, the proposed module groups query features and image tokens into divided local view spaces and performs visibility-aware cross-attention within each view. This design reduces irrelevant cross-view interference and helps the model better align language instructions with local driving-relevant visual evidence. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/feel12348/doscenes-omnidrive.
tldr: Adapts OmniDrive for instruction-conditioned trajectory prediction by adding a divided-view perception module that reduces cross-view interference and improves language-instruction grounding.
tldr_zh: 改进了OmniDrive，通过引入分视角感知模块来减少跨视角干扰，提升语言指令与视觉特征的匹配能力，用于指令驱动的轨迹预测。
summary_zh: 基于指令的轨迹预测是自动驾驶领域的一个新兴问题，该任务要求模型不仅依据视觉场景上下文和历史运动信息，还需根据自然语言操作指令来预测未来的自车轨迹。本文介绍了我们针对doScenes指令驾驶挑战赛的解决方案，该方案基于OmniDrive——一个具备三维感知、推理与规划能力的视觉-语言-动作驾驶智能体。我们通过使用带指令标注的nuScenes场景数据训练模型，并生成由12个未来路径点表示的6秒自车轨迹，从而将OmniDrive适配至doScenes场景。此外，为提升多视图视觉定位能力，我们在OmniDrive感知头中引入了DVPE风格的分割视图感知模块。该模块并非对所有摄像头特征进行全局注意力处理，而是将查询特征与图像令牌分组至分割的局部视图空间，并在每个视图内执行可见性感知的交叉注意力计算。这一设计减少了无关的跨视图干扰，有助于模型更好地将语言指令与局部驾驶相关的视觉证据对齐。代码已开源：https://github.com/feel12348/doscenes-omnidrive。

title: Inverting the Bellman Equation: From $Q$-Values to World Models
summary: Model-based and model-free reinforcement learning are traditionally viewed as separate paradigms: instead of learning a model of the transition kernel $P$, model-free agents typically estimate value functions tied to a specific policy and reward. In this paper, we challenge this dichotomy by proving that value-based agents trained on a sufficiently rich set of reward functions, e.g. using goal-conditioned RL, implicitly encode a unique and accurate world model. To extract this model in practice, we introduce \textit{$P$-learning}, an inverse analogue to $Q$-learning that samples from an agent's $Q$-values, policies and rewards to decode its internal model of the environment. We then provide sufficient conditions on the type and number of goals for which agents encode the true kernel $P$, covering both stochastic and deterministic MDPs over finite or continuous state spaces. Even when our assumptions are violated, we empirically demonstrate that agents trained on a handful of reward functions encode accurate dynamics in $\texttt{Reacher}$, $\texttt{MountainCar}$ and stochastic variants of $\texttt{FourRooms}$. Surprisingly, we find that policies trained exclusively on a \texttt{Reacher} agent's implicit world model are quasi-optimal on out-of-distribution, velocity-based goals despite position-only training -- suggesting that agents contain hidden generalisation capabilities and providing a new lens into the connection between model-based, model-free, and goal-conditioned RL.
tldr: This paper introduces P-learning, a method to extract a world model from value-based agents by inverting the Bellman equation, showing that agents trained on multiple reward functions implicitly encode accurate environment dynamics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了P-学习，通过逆向贝尔曼方程从基于价值的智能体中提取世界模型，表明在多个奖励函数上训练的智能体隐式编码了准确的环境动态。
summary_zh: 基于模型和无模型的强化学习传统上被视为两种不同的范式：无模型智能体通常不会学习转移核$P$的模型，而是估计与特定策略和奖励相关的价值函数。在本文中，我们挑战了这一二分法，证明基于价值的智能体在足够丰富的奖励函数集上训练时（例如使用目标条件强化学习），会隐式编码一个唯一且准确的世界模型。为在实践中提取该模型，我们引入了\textit{$P$-学习}，这是$Q$-学习的逆类比方法，通过从智能体的$Q$值、策略和奖励中采样，解码其内部的环境模型。随后，我们给出了关于智能体编码真实转移核$P$所需目标类型和数量的充分条件，涵盖了有限或连续状态空间上的随机和确定性马尔可夫决策过程。即使当我们的假设被违反时，我们仍通过实验证明，在少数奖励函数上训练的智能体能够在$\texttt{Reacher}$、$\texttt{MountainCar}$ 以及 $\texttt{FourRooms}$ 的随机变体中编码准确的动力学。令人惊讶的是，我们发现仅在$\texttt{Reacher}$智能体的隐式世界模型上训练的策略，在面对基于速度的分布外目标时仍准最优——尽管训练时仅涉及位置信息——这表明智能体具有隐藏的泛化能力，并为理解基于模型、无模型以及目标条件强化学习之间的联系提供了全新视角。

title: Non-line-of-sight imaging with arbitrary relay surface geometries via 3D Gaussian Transient Rendering
summary: Imaging objects hidden outside the direct line of sight expands the effective field of view and is critical for applications such as autonomous driving and robotic perception. Despite impressive progress in time-of-flight (ToF)-based non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging, real-world deployment remains challenging because practical measurements are often collected over spatially limited, arbitrarily shaped relay regions-conditions that violate the planar-wall and dense-sampling assumptions made by most existing methods. To address these limitations, we propose a LOS-guided NLOS imaging pipeline that imposes no geometric assumptions on the relay surface and naturally supports both confocal and non-confocal configurations. Our method represents the hidden scene using 3D Gaussian primitives and couples them with an efficient, differentiable transient rendering model, enabling end-to-end optimization directly from measured transients. We validate our approach on real-world measurements from both a public dataset and a custom-built capture system. Across settings, our method achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity under spatially limited, sparsely sampled conditions, and significantly outperforms existing methods on complex, arbitrary relay surface geometries.
tldr: A method for non-line-of-sight imaging that uses 3D Gaussian primitives and differentiable transient rendering to handle arbitrary relay surface geometries, improving autonomous driving and robotic perception.
tldr_zh: 一种利用3D高斯原语和可微分瞬态渲染处理任意中继曲面几何的非视线成像方法，提升自动驾驶和机器人感知。
summary_zh: 将视线外隐藏物体成像可扩展有效视场，对于自动驾驶和机器人感知等应用至关重要。尽管基于飞行时间的非视域成像技术取得了显著进展，但在实际部署中仍面临挑战，因为实际测量数据通常来自空间受限、形状任意的中继区域——这些条件违背了现有方法普遍采用的平面墙壁和密集采样假设。为突破这些限制，我们提出了一种视线引导的非视域成像流程，该方法不对中继表面施加任何几何假设，并天然支持共焦与非共焦两种配置。本方法采用三维高斯基元表征隐藏场景，并将其与高效可微的瞬态渲染模型耦合，从而实现直接基于实测瞬态数据的端到端优化。我们在公开数据集和自主搭建的采集系统上对真实测量数据进行了验证。实验表明，在空间受限与稀疏采样条件下，该方法实现了最先进的重建保真度，并在复杂、任意形状的中继表面几何条件下显著优于现有方法。

title: BadDreamer: Transferable Backdoor Attacks against Video World Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Video world models are increasingly used in autonomous driving to forecast future scene evolution and provide future-aware spatio-temporal representations for downstream action prediction. In perception-to-action pipelines, these representations can directly influence ego-vehicle waypoint planning, making the learned future dynamics a critical security-sensitive component. Despite their promise, the training-time security risks of autonomous-driving video world models remain largely unexplored. We present BadDreamer, a transferable spatio-temporal backdoor attack that targets the perception side of this pipeline. Unlike conventional backdoors that manipulate image labels, prompt outputs, or action supervision, BadDreamer poisons the learned transition dynamics of a video world model. It constructs trigger-erasure sequences in which an oncoming yellow delivery rider is visible in the observed context frames but erased from the future frames. After fine-tuning on a small fraction of such sequences, the compromised world model learns a hidden conditional association: when the physical trigger appears, it hallucinates a future where the rider disappears and the road appears clear. We further show that this corrupted future-aware representation can transfer to the downstream action module without directly modifying ego-trajectory labels, inducing unsafe non-evasive waypoint predictions. Our experiments instantiate this attack on a representative open-source perception-to-action pipeline, revealing a representation-level safety risk in autonomous-driving video world models and highlighting the need for backdoor-aware validation beyond clean generation quality.
tldr: BadDreamer proposes a backdoor attack that poisons video world models for autonomous driving by making them hallucinate cleared future frames when a specific trigger appears, leading to unsafe downstream planning.
tldr_zh: BadDreamer提出了一种针对自动驾驶视频世界模型的后门攻击，使模型在特定触发出现时错误地预测未来帧为空旷道路，从而引发不安全的规划决策。
